summary: This sermon on Daniel 6 emphasizes that usual faithfulness to God in everyday circumstances prepares believers to stand firm when persecution and trials come. Daniel's consistent practice of prayer three times daily enabled him to remain faithful even when threatened with death in the lion's den, ultimately leading to God's miraculous deliverance and the pagan king's acknowledgment of the true God.
key_points: Usual faithfulness to God prepares us for unusual circumstances
Daniel's reputation was built on his relationship with God, not temporary achievements
Spiritual formation requires intentional daily habits and disciplines
God may or may not deliver us in the moment, but His eternal promises are sure
Building life on the solid rock of Christ enables us to withstand life's storms
big_idea: Daily faithfulness to God through spiritual disciplines prepares believers to remain steadfast when persecution and hardship come, trusting that even if God doesn't deliver us in the moment, His eternal promises will be fulfilled.
title: Unusual Faithfulness
